svg.title: How Hephaestus decides whether a change made your agent better
svg.desc: Six steps. 1, write the agent: Your agent's recipe: its prompt, model, and permissions, sealed with a fingerprint so it can never change behind your back. 2, set the rules: The exam your agent sits: the tasks, the time and cost limits, and what agents are never allowed to touch. 3, try a change: Edit the recipe. The new version gets its own fingerprint and remembers exactly which version it came from. 4, fair fight: Old and new do the same tasks, same starting point, same budget, each locked in its own sandbox. 5, sealed judge: Scores both runs. The agents can never read the judge or the answers, so they can't game the test. 6, write it down: The verdict becomes a receipt in a record nobody can quietly edit. A clear winner can become Champion.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
